itens.titulo: Alphabet Crushed Cloud Expectations, But the AI Bills Are Coming Due
itens.descricao: Alphabet Crushed Cloud Expectations, But the AI Bills Are Coming Due Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares tumbled more than 11% on Thursday, plunging toward $287 and marking one of the steepest single-day sell-offs in the company's history.
ET, the Class A stock (the one with votes) is down 11.8%, and the Google parent has lost $410 billion of market value.
The correction followed Alphabet's third-quarter report, which delivered the tech giant's first bottom-line earnings miss against Wall Street consensus since the last quarter of 2022.
Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Alphabet missed the Street's bottom-line consensus, posting earnings of $2.12 per share against expectations near $3.02.
But it's fair to consider the reasons before hitting the "sell" button.

itens.titulo: Klabin vê tendência neutra para mercados em que opera
itens.descricao: Klabin vê tendência neutra para mercados em que opera Valor Econômico
trechos: A perspectiva positiva é influenciada pelo fechamento recente de capacidades de produção de “container board” nos Estados Unidos.
Desde o último ano, estima-se que cerca de 4 milhões de toneladas deste material foram retirados do mercado por conta disso.

“Sabíamos que, quando houvesse fechamento de capacidades, teríamos um efeito nos preços”, disse Teixeira, nesta quinta-feira (29), em teleconferência com analistas que discutiram os resultados do terceiro trimestre.
“Kraftliner tem um diferencial de preço comparado a outros containers boards.
No terceiro trimestre, a receita do negócio de fibra curta e longa da companhia cresceu 6%, para R$ 1,5 bilhão, apoiada por alta de 18% no preço médio em dólares da fibra curta.
Em papelão ondulado, a receita ficou estável em R$ 1,7 bilhão, amparada em reajustes de preços que compensaram a queda no volume de vendas.
Já os sacos industriais tiveram baixas de 10% nas vendas e de 7% na receita, impactados por barreiras tarifárias nas exportações.
“Sobre papelão ondulado e sacos industriais, vemos posição também de estabilidade nos próximos meses”, disse Teixeira.

itens.titulo: Bank of America plants its flag in Wisconsin
itens.descricao: Bank of America plants its flag in Wisconsin Yahoo Finance
trechos: Dive Brief: - Bank of America opened its first Wisconsin retail branch Wednesday in Madison, followed by another branch Thursday in Milwaukee, with plans to open 17 more branches statewide through 2030, according to a spokesperson.
- The 19 new branches will create roughly 130 jobs throughout the state, the bank said in a press release.
This is on top of the 170 people employed in Wisconsin within the bank's Merrill Lynch, business banking and global corporate banking arms, which already have a presence there.

- The bank will enter Louisiana and Alabama next year, with 10 branches slated for the Birmingham and Huntsville, Alabama, areas starting in early 2027, and eight in the greater New Orleans area starting in the second half of the year.
Dive Insight: The branch openings represent next steps in Bank of America's long-standing $5 billion branch expansion plan which began in 2016.

"Our clients do more and more of their banking digitally, but when they're buying a home, starting a business or planning for retirement, they want to sit down with someone they trust," Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said in a prepared statement.

Each new financial center in Wisconsin, Alabama and Louisiana is a commitment to the clients, employees and communities we serve there." Competitors JPMorgan Chase, PNC, TD and others are expanding their physical footprints.
Banks opened more branches than they closed for three recent consecutive quarters for the first time since 2009, according to data from the National Community Reinvestment Coalition.
